resources.string: Connect to the library prepared by MPA on your computer
Connect this phone to your library through Google Drive. Your computer does the processing; your phone can browse the saved results while the computer is asleep.
Choose the Google account for this saved library.
Approving the connection does not mean that shared photos have finished syncing.
In MPA on your computer, open Settings → Library workspace → Show library connection code. Copy that code here.
Finish Google sign-in, then return here to review the library.
